title: CRLF empty frontmatter closing bounds
invariant: The closing separator starts at or after opening_end - 1; the CRLF empty frontmatter case returns bounds (5, 4, 10) and body X.
scope: Bounded regression for frontmatter_bounds and source_body on the concrete bytes ---\r\n---\r\nX. Models are generated from the preserved historical full source files by C74 carrier_model. The old third re.search argument is flags, not a start position. The fixed compiled regex uses pos. This case does not prove equivalence for other inputs or Python-to-Lean translation. Restore scope: carrier_body__pub.py only; historical LAYER_3 became LAYER_4 at bf0488bff6a15a601c537f7b3e670d70aa451bf0 with identical source bytes.
